capabilities: Preview external Markdown files in read-only tabs
Save editable copies into a chosen vault folder
Discard previews by closing the tab
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.7.2 or later). Not yet listed in the community plugins directory, so manual installation is required for now. Bilingual English/Chinese README. The plugin does not upload notes or usage data, but Obsidian may load remote resources such as images referenced by the file.
problem: Obsidian cannot preview Markdown files stored outside the vault without first importing them as notes.
summary: Plugin that previews external Markdown files in read-only temporary tabs when dragged into Obsidian, with an option to save a copy into the vault.
